This is perhaps our most significant addition. The system now uses machine learning to automatically analyze your data access patterns and optimize sync frequency in real-time. Instead of fixed intervals, the algorithm learns when your files are actually needed and adjusts sync intensity accordingly. For example, if you're working on a project and only accessing certain folders, the system reduces background sync activity on those idle folders while maintaining priority syncs for active workspaces.

### 2. **Cross-Platform Workspace Unification** (Released: April 2, 2026)
We've expanded our compatibility beyond the traditional desktop-cloud model. Now your CloudSync workspace seamlessly integrates with Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android, and emerging edge devices. Multi-device collaboration is native — team members can edit documents simultaneously regardless of their physical location, with conflict resolution built into the workflow itself.

### 3. **Enterprise-Grade Data Encryption Upgrade** (Released: May 10, 2026)
Enhanced security with AES-256 encryption at rest and end-to-end encrypted file transfers. We've also introduced hardware security module (HSM) integration for enterprise customers who require compliance with FIPS 140-2 standards. ### 4. **Smart Conflict Detection & Resolution** (Released: June 18, 2026)
When conflicts arise between versions of files, the system now offers intelligent resolution suggestions before manual intervention is required. It analyzes change history, author intent, and project context to propose the best merge strategy — whether that means keeping the latest version, preserving both changes, or flagging for human review.

### 5. **Real-Time Collaborative Editing** (Released: July 7, 2026)
Multiple users can now co-edit documents, spreadsheets, and presentations in real time with live cursor tracking and presence indicators. Changes are committed immediately rather than requiring explicit save operations, creating a truly collaborative environment similar to Google Docs but with full CloudSync metadata preservation.

### 6. **Automated Backup & Disaster Recovery Orchestration** (Released: August 22, 2026)
A unified backup solution that automatically snapshots entire workspaces, cross-references them against retention policies, and orchestrates recovery across multiple geographic regions. You can trigger point-in-time restores with just a few clicks, and the system proactively identifies and migrates critical data before potential outages occur.
